scope: Independent arithmetic reconciliation of saved public V tables only
external_receipt_note: Written after final ZIP creation; intentionally outside ZIP. No repackaging performed.
independent_method: stdlib csv/json/math/statistics/decimal; no registered analysis/reporting/floors function invoked

tolerances.role: Floating arithmetic agreement only; no decision/prediction threshold relaxation

formulas.ablation: effect=variant_median-OURS_median; spread=max(variant_IQR,OURS_IQR); CONTRIBUTES if effect>spread, HARMS if effect<-spread, otherwise UNCLEAR
formulas.primary: Full registered extension seed set selects extension, otherwise base
formulas.provisional: base n=10 AND base cap count>=5 AND full extension absent
formulas.undertrained_at_10: full extension selected AND selected cap count>=5
formulas.comparative: best=min C1,C2,C3 median in registered order; gap=best_median-OURS_median; spread=max(best_IQR,OURS_IQR); strict +/-spread WIN/LOSS, otherwise TIE
formulas.comparative_provisional: OURS OR C1 OR C2 OR C3 provisional, not merely the best comparator
formulas.D1_prediction: Median of ten primary per-job floor_MSE/actual_same_cohort_MSE ratios >=.5 for ETT x A4,C2,C3
formulas.slide_rounding: MSE six decimals; effects two decimals; D1 fractions three decimals
